home.tagline: Buy cloud servers and anti-DDoS products online — balance payment, auto provisioning, self-service console

login.subtitle: Sign in to the LiltIDC_OEM admin panel

install.title: Installation Wizard
install.subtitle: Set up the database and initialize your site in a few steps
install.dbNameHelp: The installer creates it automatically if missing (utf8mb4)
install.logoHelp: Image URL; leave empty to use the default icon
install.installNote: The installer will: create database & tables → create the admin account → write the config file. No restart is required afterwards.
install.successMessage: The database is initialized, the admin account is created, and the system is now installed.
install.errPort: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535
install.errDbName: Database name may only contain letters, digits, underscores and hyphens
install.errColor: Primary color must be in #RRGGBB format, e.g. #2563eb
install.errAdminUsername: Username must be 3-32 letters, digits or underscores
install.errPasswordMismatch: The two passwords do not match

admin.dashboardPlaceholder: Statistics, revenue overview and to-dos will arrive in a future batch.
admin.placeholderDescription: This module will be delivered in a future batch. Placeholder for now.

sms.title: SMS Bao (smsbao.com)
sms.description: Sends SMS via the SMS Bao HTTP API. The password is always stored as MD5.
sms.passwordHelp: Enter the plaintext password (auto MD5) or paste a 32-char MD5 hash
sms.testDescription: Really sends one test SMS with the currently saved settings

email.title: SMTP Email
email.description: Standard SMTP settings. Port 465 uses implicit TLS automatically; use the STARTTLS switch for ports 25/587.
email.tlsHelp: Enable when the server requires STARTTLS; port 465 (implicit TLS) ignores this switch
email.testDescription: Really sends one test email with the currently saved settings

templates.title: Notification Templates
templates.description: Templates are keyed by scene + channel + language. Use {placeholder} syntax in the content.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.placeholdersHelp: Available placeholders: {code} verification code, {username} member username, {amount} amount, {bill_no} invoice no., {due_date} due date, {site_name} site name (auto-injected). Unknown placeholders are kept as-is.

config.title: WHMCS-style Upstream (ZJMF)
config.description: This system runs as a downstream of the upstream billing panel: products are imported from upstream, and provisioning actions are forwarded to it (ordering arrives in a future batch).
config.usernameHelp: Phone number without +86/86 prefix, otherwise authentication fails
config.siteUrlHelp: Publicly reachable URL registered upstream as downstream_url; empty falls back to the backend listen address (upstream pushes cannot reach localhost by design)

push.title: Downstream Push (host/sync)
push.description: Register the callback URL and downstream token in the upstream panel. After provisioning or changing a host, upstream pushes to this system with an MD5 signature; verified payloads are persisted automatically.
push.tokenHelp: Signing secret; if leaked, reset it immediately and re-register upstream
push.resetConfirmDescription: The old token stops working immediately and upstream pushes signed with it will be rejected (403). You must register the new token upstream again.
push.resetDone: Downstream token reset; please update it upstream
push.notRegistered: Note: automatic registration to upstream ships with the ordering flow in a future batch; for now fill in the URL and token manually in the upstream panel.

hosts.title: Upstream Hosts (read-only)
hosts.description: Pulls the upstream host list live for reconciliation; provisioning data of record comes from host/sync pushes.

products.title: Products
products.name: Name
products.empty: No local products yet — import from upstream first

importSheet.title: Import Upstream Products
importSheet.description: Tick upstream products and set local sale prices (cost prices shown for reference). Re-submitting an imported product updates its mapping and prices (idempotent).
importSheet.selectNone: Tick at least one product first
importSheet.priceRequired: Product "{{name}}": fill in a sale price (> 0) for every cycle
importSheet.groupRequired: Product "{{name}}": pick an existing group or name a new one

members.title: Members
members.resetPwdDesc: Resetting the password of {{name}}; no old password needed. The action is audit-logged.
members.pwdRule: 8-72 chars, must contain both letters and digits
members.pwdMismatch: The two passwords do not match
members.deleteDesc: Soft delete: the member is marked deleted and the username/email/phone are released (re-registration allowed).
members.balDesc: Client {{name}} · current balance ¥{{credit}}; positive to recharge, negative to deduct, journaled
members.balAmountHelp: Signed decimal amount, e.g. +50.00 or -20.00 (deduction cannot go below zero)
